notes: 20-item bank. CAPS mix: 8 L2 / 8 L3 / 4 L4. Topics: compound interest, compound inflation, population growth — recognise multiplier r, calculate balance after n periods.

stimulus.inline: Compound (constant-ratio) growth: each new term = previous × fixed factor.

items.question:
Which table shows COMPOUND growth?

**Table A:**
| Year | Balance (R) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1 000 |
| 1 | 1 100 |
| 2 | 1 200 |
| 3 | 1 300 |

**Table B:**
| Year | Balance (R) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1 000 |
| 1 | 1 100 |
| 2 | 1 210 |
| 3 | 1 331 |
workingSteps: Table B: ratios 1100/1000 = 1,10; 1210/1100 = 1,10; 1331/1210 = 1,10 — constant ratio → compound.

stimulus.inline: Compound growth: balance = principal × (1 + r)^n. For 5% per year: factor = 1,05.

items.question: Which describes a compound-growth graph?
options: A straight line with positive slope.
An upward curve that gets steeper over time.
items.expectedAnswer: An upward curve that gets steeper over time.
workingSteps: Each year the rise is a percentage of a larger base — the curve steepens.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE: Misclassifies a relationship (constant, linear, inverse, compound).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_COMPOUND_AS_SIMPLE: Calculates compound growth as if it were simple (adds the same amount each period).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_SIMPLE_VS_COMPOUND: Conflates simple and compound interest in a comparison.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_POWER_OF_FACTOR: Multiplies (1 + r) by n instead of raising it to the power n.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_INCREASE: Adds the rise to the base instead of multiplying by (1 + r).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_DECREASE: Subtracts the fall from the base instead of multiplying by (1 − r).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_TO_DECIMAL: Misconverts percent to decimal (e.g. 5% → 5 instead of 0,05).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_SUCCESSIVE_ADD: Adds successive % changes (treats them as additive instead of compounding).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_CHANGE_DIVISOR: Divides change by the wrong base when finding an implied growth rate.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_GRAPH_SHAPE_READ: Misinterprets the shape of a compound-growth graph (e.g. thinks it's a straight line).
